# Stone-Campbell Restoration and Christian Unity Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L11 - Stone-Campbell Restoration and Christian Unity.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L11 - Stone-Campbell Restoration and Christian Unity
- Big idea: The Restoration Movement sought unity through a return to New Testament Christianity but developed its own disputes and institutions.
- Primary reading: John 17:20-23; 1 Corinthians 1:10-17; selected restoration texts

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
